The '''Sharfree Pirates''' were a band of [[Pirate/Legends|space pirates]] that operated in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They piloted [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s and [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:MT" />
{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sharfree Pirates appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sharfree Pirates were added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Nova Orion Main Quest Guide|"Nova Orion" quest series]] introduced in the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]],<ref name="SWG:MT" /> released on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="C8">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
